name: central icon system
summary: Icon system with 39 categories, three stroke widths and five corner radii, shipped for Figma, Framer and React.
description: A universal icon set browsable by category — accessibility, AI & magic, arrows, building, code, communication, security, weather, brands and more — with searchable icon names and tags. Icons come in 1, 1.5 or 2 px strokes with sharp, round, small, medium or large corners, and new icons ship weekly.
contains: 39 icon categories from accessibility to social media & brands
corner radii: sharp, round, small, medium, large
new icons added weekly (14 in the week of 5 Oct)
distribution: Figma plugin, Framer plugin, React packages
changelog browsable by day, week or month
